_comment: PRE-REGISTERED BARS. Written before the first graded run.
grade.py reads these; it does not compute them. Changing a bar after seeing
results is how a grader stops being a measurement and starts being a
rationalisation, so any change must bump `version` and appears in the
Set 2026-08-08, version 1, before the first sweep was graded.
_changelog: v2 (2026-08-08): added wipeRateScale and controlScale, and switched the
survivability and control axes from RELATIVE to SCALED-ABSOLUTE.
Why: relative comparison is unstable for small-magnitude rates and
undefined at zero. A 0.51% vs 0.30% wipe rate read as '-71% survivability'
when the real difference is 0.2 percentage points, about 0.8 extra wipes
per 392-encounter campaign. Worse, the Open Hand monk had a control rate of
exactly zero, so the Fool Monk's control axis saturated at 1.0 and could
never be tuned. Both axes are now expressed in units of 'how much
difference actually matters', which is defined at zero and stable near it.
The v1 tuning results were recomputed under v2 and are superseded.
_spellCoverageGate: Minimum combat-relevant executable spell coverage before a class's damage numbers may be published. Below this, metrics are SUPPRESSED, not estimated.
_completionTarget: Fraction of runs that should reach level 20. Below this, the harness is suspect before the classes are.
_invariantTolerance: Any invariant violation is a defect. There is no acceptable non-zero count.
_balanceBand: A homebrew subclass should sit within +/-10% of its SRD sibling on the composite of damage, survivability and control.
_wipeRateScale: One unit of survivability difference = 2 percentage points of party-wipe rate per encounter. Used as an absolute divisor so the axis is defined at zero and not dominated by noise in a tiny rate.
_controlScale: One unit of control difference = 0.25 control events per action. Absolute for the same reason: an SRD sibling can legitimately have zero control, and dividing by it is undefined.
_minAblationN: Minimum paired seeds before an ablation delta may be quoted at all.
_ciMustExcludeZero: An ablation whose 95% bootstrap CI contains zero is reported as 'no detectable effect', never as its point estimate.
_activeEffectCoverage: Every ACTIVE effect present on a character must fire at least once across the sweep. Anything that never fires is UNTESTED and must not be scored as passing.
